title: FLA import: button/symbol BG layer shape dropped — PlayButton background empty, button face missing
description: CANCELLED — premise false. Investigated byte-by-byte: the PlayButton 'BG' layer's CPicFrame is GENUINELY EMPTY in the FLA binary (frame's inherited CPicShape reads schema=5, fillCount=0, lineCount=0, 0 edges, and the frame has zero child elements — verified by dumping Symbol 3 stream /tmp/sym-3.bin and tracing readShapeData @0x58). The button face is the 'Text' layer's single linear-gradient path (8 segs, 1 fill), which we import and render correctly — its compiled ShapeBounds (xMin=-1229..xMax=1231, yMin=-458..442) EXACTLY match golden DefineShape#4. golden.swf's 17-fill DefineShape#4 is Flash's PUBLISH-TIME gradient-fill expansion (a single FLA gradient -> 17 fillStyles, most unused; bounds identical), NOT dropped FLA artwork. This is a documented byte-parity gap (tools/golden-parity.mjs SHAPE GEOMETRY -> KNOWN-GAP), semantically inert: Ruffle renders the gradient button identically. No import bug exists. (While here, fixed a real latent desync: readFillStyle capped gradient stops at 15 without consuming the rest -> would desync shapes with >15 stops; now consumes all, stores 15.)
